info.title: Shared
info.description: Shared type definitions used across all Firebolt 9 API modules.

ListenResponse.title: ListenResponse
ListenResponse.description: Returned synchronously when a client subscribes to or unsubscribes from a Firebolt event. Confirms the listen state was received by the platform.

listening.description: True if now subscribed; false if now unsubscribed

event.description: The fully-qualified event method name, e.g. Lifecycle2.onStateChanged

FireboltError.title: FireboltError
FireboltError.description: Error carrier for failed Firebolt API calls. Matches the JSON-RPC 2.0 error object structure. Error codes: 1=Unknown method, 2=Method not permitted, 3=Generic failure, 4=System failure, 5=Not implemented.
